Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
It feels so nice to just relax in the park on a beautiful day like this.
If only ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would let me rest my head on her lap...
What is it？
Um, nothing.
Save that for when we're all alone, okay？
(...She totally heard me.)
Anegasaki
This fountain park is on my usual route, so I feel pretty attached to it.
Yeah, we end up passing through here a lot even when we aren't on a date.
Before we started dating, I never thought I'd be taking walks with someone.
I guess that's how we keep making new memories in the exact same places.
Hehe, you're trying to sound cool. But I get it...
Anegasaki
There sure are a lot of couples in this park.
It is a date spot, after all. Look, over there on the grass...
Hey, don't stare so much. Or do you want to be all lovey-dovey like them？
Can we？
Geez. If you behave yourself, maybe？
Anegasaki
I used to play hide-and-seek on these shrine grounds a lot. Did you do that too？
You did, huh？ There was a small shrine back where ● used to live, too.
...Want to feel like a kid again and give it a try？
Eh？
Come on. Try and... c-a-t-c-h m-e, ▼.
Anegasaki
Hey. Since we're at a shrine and all, want to draw a fortune？
Sounds good.
...Hehe.
How was it？
S-e-c-r-e-t▼ It's a good result for me. And probably for you, too.
Anegasaki
Don't you think shrine grounds have a really unique atmosphere to them？
Like they're sacred？ If we're on a date in a place like this, the gods might get mad at us.
We aren't doing anything bad, you know？ But maybe the gods are getting a little jealous.
Haha, even if it's the gods, thinking we're being watched is a little embarrassing.
Anegasaki
It was just as good as the reviews said.
I'm glad. You thought it was good too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm relieved.
Relieved？ Why's that？
You're pretty picky about movies, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Just because the reviews are good doesn't mean I can relax.
Is that what you thought？ I like movies, but I don't mean to be that critical.
Anegasaki
Hmm, I thought it was just okay.
I see, so you thought it was somewhat interesting？
Yeah, I guess... Yeah, that's right. It was somewhat interesting, you know？
(She probably has a lot she wants to say about it...)
Anegasaki
...Were you sleeping during the movie？
What!? ...You noticed.
I can't blame you, though. I was bored too.
Were you sleeping too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
No I wasn't... ...Just for a little bit.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You've been quiet for a bit. Was it boring？
Anegasaki
It was really good. ...I just got a little emotional during their reunion scene...
Did you cry？
Don't stare at me. Come on, it's fine. I was just really moved.
Sorry. Here, have a handkerchief.
Okay, thanks.
Anegasaki
Action movies are great. They really clear your head when you have a lot on your mind.
They really do. ...Wait, did you have a lot on your mind？
No, it's just a figure of speech. I'm perfectly fine.
Oh, good. I'm glad.
Jeez, nothing gets past you.
Anegasaki
Today's was especially funny. The best part was when you burst out laughing.
Jeez, don't bring that up.
Sorry. But it's a comedy, so I think it's perfectly fine to laugh, you know？
I know, but... I want to look cool in front of you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Don't try so hard. It's fine, isn't it？ You can just be a kid when you're with me. Okay？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you not enjoy it？
Anegasaki
No, it was fun. It just felt a bit unresolved. There were a few loose ends left hanging, weren't there？
Ah, maybe those parts are only explained in the original novel.
I figured as much. Guess I'll have to read the novel too.
Sci-fi can be tough when it does stuff like this.
Tell me about it. Now it's going to bother me.
Anegasaki
What's wrong, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You're totally blank. Was it boring？
No, it's not that. Don't worry about it, okay？
I can't help but worry. You're acting weird.
Well, you see... It was really interesting.
It was？ Then why are you...
I knew I'd talk your ear off and creep you out, so I decided not to say anything at all about the plot.
(I guess I'd better not ask any questions, then...)
Anegasaki
The movie was fun, but the merch shop was amazing.
It says there's a pamphlet with an exclusive figure. Looks like it's only sold at the venue.
Should I line up and buy it for you？
No thanks! It's not like I want it.
Really？ I thought it'd be nice to line up and buy a toy for my kid.
(I'm your boyfriend, not your kid...)
Anegasaki
Wow! Another strike! You might be a bowling prodigy.
No way. It was just a fluke. Alright, it's your turn now, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Alright, here I go...
Eek!? Ugh, geez.
(Maybe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is actually a prodigy at being clumsy...?)
Anegasaki
Should we take a break？ This takes more energy than you'd think.
You really pick up the pace as you go, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Like a slow starter.
You think so？ I do get told that a lot when it comes to sports.
Then the more you play, the higher your score!
But even if I get into it, my stamina doesn't last. So I usually just finish without doing anything cool.
(...Well, that didn't go as planned.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what've you been doing to the ball this whole time？
Anegasaki
I'm asking it to be a good boy and go straight for the pins.
Haha... If it works, that's an amazing ability.
Alright, Nene... here I go. ...Please!
Yay, look, a strike!
I feel like it curved in an impossible way...
Anegasaki
I always get a little defensive before coming to places like this, but once I'm here, it's fun.
Like you just go with the flow？
Yeah, like getting swept away. Eventually I just feel like 'whatever works!'
Haha, it's fun seeing you like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. It's different from usual.
Jeez, 'fun' is a little mean.
Anegasaki
Phew... I'm a little tired. But it's a good kind of tired.
Maybe it's a bit like sports？
Maybe. Like, something is being released.
Released？ Like in your brain？
Yeah. That's probably why the fatigue feels so good.
Anegasaki
I think I'm pretty tired...
...Sorry. Was this not your thing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
No. I think I'm just a little short on oxygen. I'll be fine if I rest a bit.
I'm really sorry. Don't push yourself.
Don't apologize so much. It'll just make me feel worse.
Anegasaki
They were super popular. I think I understand why tickets are so hard to get.
We were lucky today.
I might become a fan too. You know, the one they sang during the encore...
The new ballad.
Even though he's a guy, he really understands a girl's heart. Maybe you could learn from him？
(Hmm, I don't even remember the lyrics...)
Anegasaki
Phew... I feel completely burned out.
I never thought you'd start jumping during the live, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Well... it'd be weirder if I was the only one being quiet, right？
That's true, but it seemed like you were leading the charge, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
That's not... Jeez, you were watching me that much.
Anegasaki
...A live with this kind of mature mood is nice too.
Yeah, somehow you look even sexier than usual, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
You're just saying that.
I'm serious.
I wonder about that. But we both got to feel a little more grown-up, huh？
How was the live show？ I wasn't sure if you'd like it or not, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
It was fascinating.
Fascinating？
Rap is pretty interesting. It's like tanka, with all the rhymes and rhythm.
I guess if you put it like that, maybe...
You think so？ Then rap's roots are in tanka! Right？
(But it started in America...)
Anegasaki
Voice actors are really good at singing, huh.
They're both voice jobs. It probably comes down to vocal training.
I see... They were really popular too, weren't they？
Yeah. The fans were all really intense.
All of them？ What about you？
●？ ● was... keeping it moderate! Haha!
Anegasaki
It's amazing how they can captivate the audience with just their words.
It's totally different from what you usually see on TV.
I never thought they were that funny on TV... but my impression totally changed.
A lot of their jokes only work live. They might be missing out on TV.
Just like with movies, there are so many things you can't experience on TV.
I wonder if there's anything else like that we could do for a date？
Anegasaki
I'm so glad we came to see this play. Actually, I was feeling a bit down...
You were feeling down, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Did something happen？
It's nothing major. Watching this play made me forget all about it. I feel re-energized.
I see. If it cheered you up, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, then I'm glad we saw it.
Hmm... I wonder if there are any recent songs I can actually sing.
Anegasaki
There are a lot of songs you can't sing even if you've heard them before.
I always end up losing track in the middle.
Then let's sing together？ If there's a part we don't know, we'll cover for each other.
Got it. Think we can make it to the end？
Well, we'll just have to wait and see.
You're actually really good at singing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
No way... I was trying desperately not to sing off-key.
But being able to sing a song with such a high key like that is amazing.
If you flatter me like that... I'll just have to request a song in return.
Whoa, such a hard song!? Why...
If you can sing a hard song too, we'll be even, right？ Here you go.
(...Even？)
Phew... let's take a break. Want something to drink？
Anegasaki
A drink sounds nice, but the sweets here are really popular too.
Eh？ Is that so？
...I think I'll go with the Jumbo Honey Toast. What about you？
("What about you？" Wait, is she planning to eat that all by herself...？)
When you ride a Ferris wheel, don't you wonder what you'd do if you got trapped inside？
Anegasaki
That's such a cliché situation to be in...
Kyaa！
Whoa, sorry. Maybe it's because ● said something weird.
If so, that's amazing... Then try saying we'll be trapped in here alone together forever？
(Okay, that's actually scary.)
Anegasaki
Hey, can I sit next to you？
But the weight balance...
Don't worry about the little things. Besides, mentioning a girl's weight？
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
As punishment, maybe I'll just sit right on your lap？
(...That might not be much of a punishment.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you aren't scared at all. Are you really okay？
Anegasaki
I mean, it's so obvious they're just dolls. If they were a little...
Kyaa！
...That wasn't scary, it just startled me...
Anegasaki
Hmm...
What's wrong？
This haunted house would be so much scarier if they just put in a little more effort.
Listening to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it sounds like you're one of the staff members.
That might be fun. I'd love to design it however I want just once.
(If they actually let her, she'd probably make something terrifying...)
Anegasaki
Thank you... for holding my hand.
Well, I couldn't just leave you when you were that scared.
Yeah, I can't do it alone. I can't ride unless someone is holding my hand...
...Just 'someone,' huh.
Ah, my mistake♪ I meant 'unless you are,' okay？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, your smile is looking a bit stiff. Are you okay？
Anegasaki
...It feels like that rush in a movie right before an incident happens...
Now that you mention it, maybe？ You seem pretty relaxed.
Whoaaaa!!
Kyaaaaa!!
Today was really fun. I'm exhausted, though...
Anegasaki
We still have the night parade left, don't we？ Look...
(With this atmosphere, maybe I could put my arm around her shoulder...)
It's so romantic. ...Hey, can I lean on you？
Ah... yeah, of course.
...Mhm, thanks.
Anegasaki
Haa... I can't help but sigh. Words really can't describe it, can they？
A land of dreams... For now, ● and I are a part of that dreamland too.
Aren't you being a bit more romantic than usual？
...Maybe.
Then, will you be my very own prince for today？
I'd be happy to.
Can you see the parade, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ It's so crowded, we can't get any closer...
Anegasaki
It can't be helped. We can't just cut in line.
But we came all this way... Want a piggyback ride？
That might be... a bit problematic. But you know, it's fine.
It gives us a reason to come back together, right？ Let's go up front next time.
Anegasaki
...Jeez, it's embarrassing when you stare at me like that, you know？
Sorry, I'll be careful. I'll try not to look.
No. Not looking at me is also bad.
Eh？
Because then you'll try to look at other people, won't you？ So no.
(She's hard to please...)
It's crowded. In the lazy river, everyone's just soaking and floating.
Anegasaki
...What should we do. Wanna grab a drink by the pool for now？
We came all this way... The competition pool is pretty empty.
Well... competition pools are deep, right？ I don't think I can.
It's fine, there's hardly anyone there. Just hold onto ● and swim slowly.
Hold onto you？ ...But I'm heavy, we'll sink together.
(That's not true at all...)
Anegasaki
I have a question... Do you think I should learn how to swim？
Maybe, but... there's no need to force yourself.
Ah, you think I can't... I'm gonna do it! Can I ask for private lessons？
Of course, I'll help you.
But... teach me gently. Please, Coach ▼.
(Coach, huh... I kinda like that.)
Anegasaki
Hey... floating like this, doesn't it feel magical, like we're in the stars？
...Yeah.
Together... just like this... drifting somewhere far away...
Letting ourselves be swept away... might be nice.
It really does feel like that, doesn't it？
...It's beautiful.
Anegasaki
...Yeah.
Um... the starry sky, I mean.
Jeez... I know that.
And... you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Just kidding.
Don't just tack it on like that. You should say it properly, without being shy.
...I wonder if all the constellations have stories like this.
Anegasaki
Seems like it. Are you getting interested？
...I did think it looked a little interesting.
Me too, a bit. There was an exhibit in the lobby, so let's go take a look.
Sounds good.
Yeah, it's a plan.
Anegasaki
So, they have plants from different regions in each block here, huh.
I guess that means they've recreated climates from all over the world.
Like, the room next to the Amazon might suddenly be the top of a Swiss mountain.
That'd be pretty tough on the people looking at them.
Hehe, I'm sure they've thought about the visitors, so it should be fine.
It smells sweet in here.
Anegasaki
...Yeah. But isn't it a little too strong？
Yeah, I feel like I'd get a headache if we stayed long.
Right. It's nice in small doses, but... Want to go somewhere else？
Yeah, let's keep moving.
I wonder what the next room will smell like♪
(Is that what she's looking forward to？)
Anegasaki
Rare plants are nice, but normal flowers blooming in a garden are soothing too.
Yeah, coming to a place like this might actually make you realize that.
Actually, huh. That's funny.
I guess it means happiness is surprisingly close by.
...Yeah. My happiness is right here, see？ Well within my reach.
Anegasaki
Hey, did you have fun？
Um... Yeah, I think I had fun...
Jeez, you're totally trying to read my expression.
Sorry, I was just worried about your reaction, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Well, I had a ton of fun. So I'll forgive you♪
You were pretty quiet, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Were you bored？
Anegasaki
No, not at all. Did it look that way？
...Hmm？
Sometimes I just end up enjoying things quietly like this.
Oh, I see.
Yeah, that event was... pretty fun, I guess.
Anegasaki
Hey...
Yes...
That was a bit too awful just now, wasn't it.
So you thought so too, ●. I can't believe they invite guests for that.
...Sigh. I guess we can just chalk today up as a learning experience.
(Yeah, I'll keep that in mind...)
Anegasaki
I thought classical concerts were a lot more stuffy.
It was pretty casual, huh？ They had everything from nursery rhymes to anime songs.
Yeah, it's definitely a relief when they play a song you know. ...I want to come again.
I'm glad to hear you say that, ●.
Besides, going to a classical concert for a date is pretty cool, don't you think？
I thought idol concerts were only fun for the fans, but that's not true at all.
Anegasaki
Yeah, I don't know much about them, but the one who was the MC at the end...
The one with the Kansai dialect？ She was a great talker.
Yeah, I think I might've become a fan just from listening to her talk.
Haha, think you might get hooked？
Would that be a problem for you？ Fufu♪
Anegasaki
Live musicals really are the best.
Yeah, it's totally different from movies.
I was already excited before it started, but now that it's over, I'm even more pumped.
It's rare to see you get like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I guess this is what they mean by a dreamlike state... It feels nice.
Are you tired, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
...A little. I think the heat of the moment got to me.
It's almost like you were the one in the match, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I couldn't even pretend to do that. Just watching makes me like this.
Haha.
If I got in the ring, I'd probably pass out the second the bell rings.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you not know the rules of baseball？
Anegasaki
Eh？
You looked pretty confused a lot of the time.
To be honest... not really.
I knew it... It must not have been fun to watch, then...
No, it was fun. Cheering with the older guys around us... It was a weird sense of unity.
Oh, that's good then.
You were worried about that？ You need to stop worrying and just enjoy yourself, okay？
How was it？ Was it mostly movie stuff？
Anegasaki
Yeah... but besides that, the accessories were interesting.
Ah, the handmade ones.
Anything goes, huh？ Not just books, but CDs, games, and trinkets.
Yeah, and I bet we still haven't seen everything.
There sure are a lot of diverse hobbies in the world, huh？
Haha, for real.
Anegasaki
Around late elementary school, I used to dream of going on a date with my boyfriend at the Bay Bridge like this.
Wow, since elementary school？ Girls really mature fast.
Maybe. All my friends agreed with me, too.
It might be an exaggeration, but I guess one of your dreams came true.
Yeah... It's not a big deal anymore, but when you think about it, it's a really wonderful thing...
Anegasaki
...I don't think you should look to the side too much.
Hm？ ...Whoa, they're kissing.
Jeez, don't say it out loud.
Sorry. ...But there are quite a few other couples here...
Never mind them. You're a good boy, right？
...Yeees.
Anegasaki
I heard they closed off the bridge to film a drama the other day.
Wow. There's a lot of traffic, so that must've been tough.
They filmed early in the morning before traffic. My favorite actor is starring, so I wanted to go see it.
You should've gone.
Around that time, I was busy meeting you in my dreams.▼
Huh？ A dream about ●？
Yep. You beat out a handsome actor, so you should be proud♪
The sun's a bit too strong. Did you put on sunscreen？
Anegasaki
I did, but with it this strong, it might not do much.
I see... Girls have it rough.
But... we came all the way to the beach. It'd be a waste not to have fun, right？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Come on! Hurry up~♪
Anegasaki
Hmm...
What's wrong？
I'm worried about my tan lines. I wonder how they look.
Oh... How do they look？
Like I'd show you... Perv.
(Now I'm curious...)
Anegasaki
Phew... I'm worn out. The ocean at dusk makes me sleepy...
Yeah. I wonder if I'll last until we get home...
Jeez, you're so cute, ▼. Just like a kid.
Haha, maybe...
It's okay, you can rest for a little bit.
Yeah, I'll do that...
Anegasaki
Listening to the waves on a quiet beach is nice, too.
It makes the summer hustle and bustle feel like a lie.
There's no one around, huh？
Hey, tell me you love me？
Yes...
An empty beach is a little lonely, isn't it？
Anegasaki
Ah, getting sentimental.
...Maybe.
Then today, Nene-san will listen to your life troubles.
No, it's not that bad. Plus, I'm happy as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is by my side right now.
Ah... Jeez, just because no one is listening, you say things like that...
Anegasaki
In old teen dramas, they'd yell 'You idiot!' and run, right？
Oh, is that so... Old dramas, huh.
Ah, I don't know that much about them! I just happened to see a rerun!
Haha, I know. We're only one year apart, anyway.
...Right. Yeah, we're only one year apart♪
(Does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ look happy？)
Anegasaki
Mmm...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, why are you glaring at the tank？
...Wait, were you watching me this whole time？
Yeah... Were you doing a sunfish impression?
Yeah, kinda. This little guy is just so charming, right？
(But when she puffs out her cheeks, she looks more like a pufferfish...)
Sunfish look like they don't have a care in the world. I'm kinda jealous.
Anegasaki
You wanna be a sunfish？
That might be nice.
But some places actually eat sunfish, you know. You might end up as someone's dinner？
Eh？
Hmm, I wonder... if you'd be tasty？
Don't say that while staring at me...
Anegasaki
Don't you think the comical way penguins move is super soothing？
You mean how they waddle around like this？
Ahaha! You do a really good penguin impression♪
...I didn't think it'd be THAT funny... I'm a little hurt.
Don't be so down. It's okay, you were really cute, ▼.
Anegasaki
I wonder if penguins ever wish they could fly.
With those chubby bodies, it'd be pretty tough... They'd need some huge wings.
...That might not be very cute.
Now that I picture it, it's actually kinda scary.
Yeah. Penguins are perfectly fine being cute as they are.
Anegasaki
Just a slight change in how we see the tank... So magical. It takes my breath away.
It really feels like we're at the bottom of the sea... Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Thinking about being at the bottom of the sea is a bit scary. Plus, I can't swim...
It's fine! If we were at the bottom of the sea, being able to swim wouldn't help!
Eh... Geez, that doesn't solve anything.
Anegasaki
I wonder how many fish are just in this tunnel.
If you count the small ones, there's tens of thousands... or so the sign says.
Tens of thousands of fish...
Yeah...
Geez, your stomach growling just from looking at fish... You're such a boy.
Anegasaki
When you think of aquariums, the main attraction has to be the dolphin show, right？
Probably. It definitely draws the biggest crowd.
I think when I was little, I used to say I wanted to be a dolphin trainer!
Don't they have a program for that？ Wanna sign up？
...I think I'll pass. I'm actually a little scared of them.
Haha, guess being a trainer would be pretty tough then.
Anegasaki
I wonder if it's true that dolphins can understand human words.
Hmm, let's test it out. Go ahead, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Me？ Um... Squeak, squeak, squeeeeak.
...What was that？
'The guy next to me is my boyfriend.' Do you think they got the gist of it？
(I doubt they got it... but that was really cute.)
Anegasaki
The sea breeze feels so nice, doesn't it？
Mmm! It makes you forget all your worries.
Worries... Like what？
Um... Haha, I actually forgot.
Haha, so it worked. That's good.
The wind's picking up a bit... Are you cold？
Anegasaki
A little... But maybe this is just right. Because...
...Hmm？
...You can feel my body heat, right？
See？ Not cold anymore.
They say the view from here is the prettiest in the park.
Anegasaki
You sure know a lot. Have you been here with someone else？
No way! It just said so on the sign.
So cuuute.▼
Sorry. Let's enjoy the prettiest view, okay？
Looking around, there's probably a lot of places in this town I don't know.
Anegasaki
That might be true. Even I don't know it all.
Really？
Yeah, though I've lived here longer than you, so I probably know more.
Then show me around.
Eh？ ...Ahem. The tour will now begin. If you look to your right...
There are some pretty weird souvenirs here.
Anegasaki
Keychains are standard, but... why do they have wooden swords？
Yeah, they have nothing to do with the tower...
Maybe this place was a dojo before the tower was built... Hence the swords.
Uhh...
Ah, don't give me that look. It's true, this place used to be a dojo!
(You don't have to be so stubborn about it...)
Anegasaki
It's almost time...
Almost time for what？
Oh!
At this time of day, all the ships in the harbor blow their whistles.
Wow, you sure know your stuff.
Hehe, pretty cool, huh!
Anegasaki
Sorry for making you tag along.
It's fine. Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ having fun makes it fun for ● too.
Thanks. ...Well then, maybe I'll try this on too.
Yeah.
Um... Instead of 'yeah', could you maybe step away from the fitting room？
Sorry!
Anegasaki
Um... Could you hand me that blouse hanging over there？
Sure... But how...？
Through the gap in the curtain... You absolutely can't peek, okay？
......I know, I know.
What's with the pause？ Answer right away.
Okay！
Girls really love their accessories.
Anegasaki
Yeah, it's fun just looking at them.
Just looking, huh... But you still want one, right？
Well, of course...
Hmm...
Jeez, you're not getting any weird ideas, are you？ We're both high schoolers, so don't push yourself, okay？
Anegasaki
Hey, hey.
Oh, where did you go？
A clerk over there asked me, 'Are you looking for an engagement ring？'
An engagement ring!？
I guess we look like that... That's a bit embarrassing, huh？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks happy...)
You were talking with the clerk. Do you come here often？
Anegasaki
Not often, but sometimes.
Wow, that's kind of cool.
Cool？ Why？
Having a regular shop seems kind of grown-up, doesn't it？
It's not that big of a deal... Jeez, you're so cute.
Anegasaki
It looks like we can ask for a makeup simulation.
A makeup simulation？
You can try out different makeup based on a photo taken with a digital camera. Do you want to try it out？
●!？ I'm good, ●!
Ehh! I think it'd be fun, though~？
(I don't want my girlfriend seeing me like that...)
It's quiet once you get around here...
Anegasaki
...A terrifying string of murders at a quiet lakeside. Will they be able to survive？
...What？
It's the tagline for a movie I saw recently. The atmosphere here is similar.
